purpose: South-pole source and uploaded-reference provenance inventory; NOT a trained dataset or independent scientific validation
source_policy: Scientific computation only from native data products with labels, checksums, frames, epochs and independent validation; reference images never substitute for DEMs

sources.name: LRO LOLA south-polar GDR
sources.processing_role: Input to reproducible terrain skyline after PDS3 label parsing, projection validation and physics QA
sources.science_gate: UNVERIFIED until independent ray-casting/topography and ephemeris validation

sources.name: High-resolution LOLA south-pole sites
sources.native_resolution: 5 m/pixel gridded GeoTIFF; actual detail depends on LOLA sample density
sources.coverage: Selected south-polar landing-site regions (e.g. Site01 Connecting Ridge, Site04 Shackleton rim)
sources.processing_role: Cross-resolution topography, slope, source-density and uncertainty sensitivity
sources.science_gate: Verify each GeoTIFF CRS, MOON_ME DE421, nodata, product-specific size and checksum before using

sources.name: 87-90 S LOLA south-pole mosaic
sources.processing_role: Long-range skyline validation beyond local landing-site raster
sources.science_gate: Very large rasters; process with spatial windows and do not conflate interpolation with measured terrain

sources.name: Enhanced topography via shape-from-shading
sources.coverage: 13 original Artemis III candidate landing regions
sources.processing_role: Sensitivity checks for locally illuminated terrain detail; not an independent full-darkness ground truth
sources.science_gate: Check version and validation, distinguish inferred illuminated detail from direct altimetry

sources.name: LROC NAC/WAC native data and map products
sources.processing_role: Context and candidate feature identification; individual products require calibrated geometry and IDs
sources.science_gate: Do not infer metres or PSR boundaries from an unreferenced screenshot; use original PDS product labels
sources.attribution: LROC SOC; NASA/GSFC; imagery source-specific credit

sources.name: Danuri/KPLO ShadowCam data archive
sources.processing_role: Qualitative inspection of permanently shadowed regions using calibrated, map-projected products
sources.science_gate: Illumination/noise calibration and product geometry before interpreting imagery; not direct proof of water ice

sources.name: Chandrayaan-2 OHRC
sources.processing_role: Candidate cross-check for terrain appearance and landform identification
sources.science_gate: ISRO states copyright and noncommercial scientific-use restrictions; do not bulk ingest, redistribute or train without terms review and permission where required

sources.name: SLDEM2015 LOLA + SELENE Terrain Camera
sources.processing_role: Do not use as south-pole terrain ground truth; may be used outside polar footprint with explicit coverage check
sources.science_gate: Fail closed for latitude south of -60 deg
sources.attribution: Barker et al. 2016; LOLA/SELENE Terrain Camera

sources.name: Lunar South Pole Terrain in Coded Color
sources.processing_role: Educational color/elevation illustration, craters and product credits, not numerical DEM pixels
sources.science_gate: Do not train physical visibility predictions from rendered color/lighting
sources.attribution: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio; visualization credits on source page

sources.name: Lunar South Pole Atlas
sources.processing_role: Source comparison and curated regional map references; verify particular map's projection and date
sources.science_gate: Illustrations and derived maps require original numeric raster for physics

sources.name: LROC QuickMap
sources.processing_role: Discover native image product identifiers and coordinate footprints
sources.science_gate: Respect site terms and do not scrape map tiles as training data

sources.name: NASA Moon Trek
sources.processing_role: Visual comparison, search for terrain and elevation layers and provenance
sources.science_gate: Some advanced planning tools require registered access; outputs remain external until independently verified
